draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.69, the 229th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 12th of 13 at RB. He went 90th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (229th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,040 rushing yards in 2025, 5th of 13 RBs in his class with stats.
